name: Asphyxia
source:
[i]High school is almost over and you haven't confessed to your eternal crush. Will you have the chance before graduating?[/i]

Ari, the protagonist, has always been in love with the same girl. Since they were just kids. The thing is, should she confess her love? 

"Asphyxia" explores different opinions about getting out of the closet. 

Would you explore them, as well?

[From [url=https://mendu.itch.io/asphyxia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[i]高中快结束了，你还没有承认你永恒的暗恋。毕业前还有机会吗？[/i]

主角阿里一直爱着同一个女孩。因为他们还只是孩子。问题是，她该承认自己的爱情吗？

《窒息》探讨了关于出柜的不同观点。

你也会探索它们吗？

[来自[url=https://mendu.itch.io/asphyxia]Itch.io[/url]]
